Katalon Lab · record, verify, play back, heal

Build a Katalon test by using the app.

This is how Katalon Studio's Record Web works. Press Record and use the ChargeFlow app: every click and every value you type becomes a WebUI step, and every element you touch is saved in the Object Repository with its locators. Add verification checkpoints, then play the test back. You can also run it against a data file, or change the app's HTML and see self-healing find the moved buttons.

01 · RECORDCapture actions

Clicks, typing and selections become Groovy keyword steps.

02 · OBJECTSObject Repository

Each element is stored once with XPath, CSS and attribute locators.

03 · VERIFYCheckpoints

Click "Add verification", then click an element to assert its text.

04 · EXECUTEPlayback & data

Replay once, or once per row of a data file (data-driven testing).

05 · MAINTAINSelf-healing

If a locator breaks after a UI change, Katalon tries the other locators.

Application under test · staging
Data file Data Files/BatteryLevels (CSV). In a Test Suite, Katalon binds the battery and expected columns to test case variables and runs the case once per row. The template books C-01 with that battery level and checks the priority badge, or the validation error.
